entry.title: Beat & Dungeon 1.1.0
entry.summary: A role-playing game for beatmakers: the project is a dungeon, each track a room, and a D20 sets the rule for the next one (sound, tempo, curses, creatures, gold to spend at the merchant). It plays no sound itself: it guides your beat. English. Built with the Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.

entry.title: Beat & Dungeon 1.0.0
entry.summary: **Beat & Dungeon 1.0.0** — a role-playing game for beatmakers on the MPC's screen. A project is a dungeon, every track is a room, a D20 decides the rule you compose by. **Download:** `Beat-and-Dungeon-1.0.0-mpc-sdk.zip` (built with Akai's official MPC Plugin SDK; one zip for 32-bit and 64-bit MPCs, MPC OS 3.10.1 or later). **Install:** unzip, copy `Gonzi Audio - VST - Beat & Dungeon` into `VST2 Plugins` on a USB drive or SD card, turn on Preferences > Enhancements (Beta) > Enable Enhancements +
